tooltip.burmaldaholic.ledger_page: Someone owes a lot of chips. Hopefully not you.

gui.burmaldaholic.loan.admin.wave_failed: No wave: the player is not overdue, already has a squad, collectors are off, or there is no safe spot nearby
gui.burmaldaholic.loan.no_new_overdue: No new loans while you are overdue

msg.burmaldaholic.loan.repaid_on_time: Repaid on time. The Shark likes you now. Slightly lower interest next time.
msg.burmaldaholic.loan.warning_final: Your loan of %1$s is due in 2 minutes. Tick tock.
msg.burmaldaholic.loan.defaulted: You missed the deadline. The loan is overdue: %1$s. Expect visitors.
msg.burmaldaholic.loan.one_at_a_time: One loan at a time. The Shark isn't a charity.
msg.burmaldaholic.loan.cooldown: After your last stunt, no loans for %1$s
msg.burmaldaholic.loan.asset_freeze: Asset freeze: %1$s seized from your balance. Wagering is blocked until the debt is paid.
msg.burmaldaholic.loan.wave_incoming: Debt collectors are on their way. You owe %1$s
msg.burmaldaholic.loan.wave_queued: Collectors came by while you were away. They'll be back shortly.
msg.burmaldaholic.loan.paid_in_full_coll: Debt cleared. The collectors lose interest in you.
msg.burmaldaholic.loan.partial_collector: Paid %1$s. The squad leaves — for today. Still owed: %2$s
msg.burmaldaholic.loan.repossessed: Repossessed: %1$s from your balance and your %2$s
msg.burmaldaholic.loan.squad_defeated: The squad is down. The debt isn't.
msg.burmaldaholic.loan.balance_cap: Your balance can't hold this loan: room for only %1$s. Spend some chips first.
dialog.burmaldaholic.loan.greeting.1: Step into my office. Mind the sharks.
dialog.burmaldaholic.loan.greeting.2: Short on chips? Happens to the best of us. Mostly to the rest of us.
dialog.burmaldaholic.loan.greeting.3: I believe in you. I also believe in interest.
dialog.burmaldaholic.loan.greeting.4: Everybody wins eventually. Until then — me.
dialog.burmaldaholic.loan.greeting.5: Friendly rates for friendly faces. Yours will do.
dialog.burmaldaholic.loan.given.1: Pleasure doing business. Don't make me miss you.
dialog.burmaldaholic.loan.given.2: Spend it wisely. Or at least quickly.
dialog.burmaldaholic.loan.given.3: That's the easy part. The hard part is giving it back.
dialog.burmaldaholic.loan.given.4: Red or black — just come back.
dialog.burmaldaholic.loan.repaid.1: Paid in full. A rare and beautiful thing.
dialog.burmaldaholic.loan.repaid.2: You're a person of your word. I'll remember that.
dialog.burmaldaholic.loan.repaid.3: And here I was, sharpening my pencil.
dialog.burmaldaholic.loan.repaid.4: Come back anytime. I mean it. Financially.
dialog.burmaldaholic.loan.overdue.1: Well, well. Look who remembered where I live.
dialog.burmaldaholic.loan.overdue.2: You're late. I don't like late. My associates like it even less.
dialog.burmaldaholic.loan.overdue.3: We were on "you" terms. Now we're on "you owe" terms.
dialog.burmaldaholic.loan.overdue.4: Every day you're late, the number gets bigger. Math is cruel.
dialog.burmaldaholic.loan.overdue.5: Pay up and we forget this ever happened. Mostly.
dialog.burmaldaholic.loan.refuse_vip.1: That kind of money is for people with a better card than yours.
dialog.burmaldaholic.loan.refuse_vip.2: Play a bit more first. I like to know my clients.
dialog.burmaldaholic.loan.refuse_vip.3: Ambitious. I like it. The answer's still no.
dialog.burmaldaholic.loan.piglin_greetin: Gold? Chips? I lend both. Returns are… mandatory.
Snort. You look like someone who needs a loan.
dialog.burmaldaholic.accountant.audit.2: According to my records, you're in trouble.
dialog.burmaldaholic.enforcer.line.2: I don't do math. I do follow-ups.
dialog.burmaldaholic.enforcer.line.3: Boss sent me. That's bad news for you.
config.burmaldaholic.loan.collectors.ena: If off, overdue debts are handled by an asset freeze on every difficulty
config.burmaldaholic.loan.partialPayment: Partial payment that sends a wave away
config.burmaldaholic.loan.repossessItem: Seize most valuable item on death
